ideas.title: The friends are the battery
ideas.critique: This is the round-1 clay-pot cell again, with the single real change the critic asked for: the friends carry it, and what they want decides the circuit, so the motor's speed follows their moods and not a script. That is a creature interaction a watcher could share. The risks are that 'how they stand' turns into a hand-wired series/parallel switch, and that 'whistle and nudge' turns into teleporting a friend into a slot. If the motor is in the shot only as a spinning prop, this is a fixed camera on a device again.

ideas.title: A kite that charges the plates
ideas.critique: The island has never had a steered skill toy where a player's own swoops make stored energy, and the crosswind-squared pull is a real lesson you feel in your hands. It is also a strong traced sky shot. The weak points: Lumi holding the line in its beak beside a drum it can't hold back, the lead plates resting on round-1's oversized Plante cell, and a lodestone-stator generator that can't hold 400 W however hard the line pulls, so the 'charge' will be faked or close to nothing.

ideas.title: Copper leaves: plate anything in the blue salt
ideas.nearest: A copper wire keeps its bends
same_form: A copper wire keeps its bends
ideas.critique: A current distribution solved on any mesh, giving thick tips, thin hollows and burnt deposits, is general and works for whatever the player dips. Gifts the friends then wear give it a life past the jar. The film is still an object dipped and pulled out, close and fixed, with a colour change as the payoff, and it moves the cart forward only indirectly.
